title: Establish cross-team signoff flow for PRD changes affecting privacy & rollout toggles
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Context: Recent PRD updates to the 'runtime pinning' and 'region-aware rollout toggles' introduce new data residency checks and a staging-only UI toggle. This ticket creates a deterministic signoff flow so PRD changes that touch privacy, legal obligations, or global rollout gating get explicit alignment from Eng, Design, and Legal before dev work starts.

Goal: Reduce rework and late-stage scope changes by defining roles, deadlines, and a minimal checklist for acceptance. Outcome should be a one-page signoff artifact and a templated checklist added to the PRD template and the Console release runbook.
acceptance_criteria: A one-page signoff artifact exists (PDF/Confluence) that lists required approvals and their SLOs for PRDs that change privacy / dataflow / rollout toggles.
Design, Engineering, and Legal owners are named and have confirmed availability windows for reviews (documented in the signoff artifact).
A minimal checklist is added to the PRD template and used by the next three PRDs; checklist items are validated in PRD reviews.

Automated gating: a new PRD label 'requires-cross-signoff' is introduced and visible in Linear; any ticket with that label must include the completed signoff artifact before status can move to 'Planned'.
Two reference cases documented: (1) privacy-sensitive rollout across EU regions, (2) experimental rollout toggle with telemetry—each showing how the flow prevents scope rework.
